summary: A table of four products with an inline sparkline per row and a text trend label.
use: Adding a mini trend line to table rows, such as revenue history per product.
spec: `rows` has 4 products: Atlas Pro, Nova Suite, Relay SDK, Mesh API, each with 6 `revenue` values and a `trend`
`<Sparkline data={row.revenue} trend={row.trend} height="32px" />` in each row
`labels` maps `up`, `down` and `neutral` to `'▲ Growing'`, `'▼ Declining'` and `'→ Stable'`
